decisions.primaryLocator: NI2022 physical/printed16, EP5 Technische Verfahren, Kommunikation; whole page text and actual render read.
decisions.scientificRationaleDe: Der unveränderte ganze Owner beschreibt Fraktionierung UND thermisches Cracken; der neue NI-Fall verlangt tatsächlich die Erklärung des vorhandenen, lesbaren Verfahrensschemas mit F1–F5 und Temperaturgefälle. Der materielle Weg Kolonne→leichte/schwere Fraktion ist eine Trennung vorhandener Moleküle; die zusätzliche Crackstufe verändert Moleküle. C12H26→C7H16+C5H10 ist atomar bilanziert, Heptan/Alken sind im gewählten Modell möglich, aber nicht das zwingende reale Produktspektrum. Der ausdrücklich falsche zweite Bypass ist sichtbar als Fehler markiert und verlangt kausale Widerlegung an der fehlenden Reaktionsstufe. Das ist ein neuer direkter Schemanachweis am richtigen Inhalt und keine Übertragung des HB-Zusatzes.
decisions.scientificRationaleEn: The unchanged whole owner covers fractionation and thermal cracking. The new NI case actually requires use of the legible F1–F5 diagram and its temperature gradient. Separation preserves molecules; cracking changes them. The C12H26 split is atom-balanced but predicts no unique real product distribution. A clearly labelled false bypass requires reasoning about the missing chemical stage. This directly evidences schematic use without relabelling the HB route.
decisions.actualTransfer: Changed bypass/outlet must be distinguished from molecular cleavage by referring to the two actual diagrams, not simply repeating a definition.
decisions.stageCourseBoundary: NI Einführungsphase EP5 only. Technical GK/LK CrossStage placements do not imply an extra LK/Q duty. No own-schema-creation requirement imported from HB.
decisions.wholeProfileAssessment: The whole old four expectations,three cases and coverage settings are exact prefixes/preserved values. HB18/20 entire expectation,axis and case are unchanged. NI append is source-conditioned; outside that route no new completion duty.
openDuties: No whole NI technical-process curriculum clearance: Erdgas/Biogas, chromatography, other process or professional/economic standards are not approved here.
No real plant operation or observed learner work. Native D/P binding and activation remain separate.

decisions.primaryLocator: ST2022 physical/printed11 mandatory pupil execution and full physical/printed22 named experiment; both whole text and actual renders read.
decisions.scientificRationaleDe: Der ganze aktuelle Owner fordert wirklich angeleitete sichere Durchführung, eigenes Protokoll und Hypothesenbezug. Die neue verbindliche ST-Route lässt jede Person nach örtlicher Freigabe einen kleinen Magnesiumbandansatz im bedeckten Tiegel selbst umsetzen, eigene Schritte/Befunde und Aufsicht nachweisen und Beobachtung von Deutung trennen. 2Mg+O2→2MgO und Gruppe2/Erdalkalimetall sind korrekt. Weißes Hauptprodukt und Wärme/Licht werden nicht mit Reinheit verwechselt; mögliche Restmetalle/Nebenprodukte bleiben offen. RSC2026 trägt den bedeckten Tiegelweg, RiSU trägt örtlichen Alters-/Einrichtungs- und optischen Schutz, DGUV die Metallbrandgrenzen. Vollständiges Abkühlen, trockene Trennung und kein Weitergeben ungeprüfter Asche an den Wasseransatz sind fachlich/sicherheitlich wesentlich und tatsächlich enthalten.
decisions.scientificRationaleEn: The current whole owner requires safe guided personal conduct, an own record and hypothesis evaluation. The new ST route requires each pupil to carry out the locally released small covered-crucible preparation and provide own action/observation and supervision evidence. The Mg/O2 equation and group2 classification are correct; whiteness is not treated as purity. The reviewed RSC method, RiSU optical/local assessment requirements and DGUV fire restrictions support the bounded design. Complete cooling, dry segregation and exclusion of unverified ash from the water experiment are explicitly preserved.
decisions.actualTransfer: After their own record the learner rejects a proposed fully open lid/direct view without performing the unsafe variation and evaluates separately labelled reference evidence of residual metal.
decisions.safetyDesignDecision: APPROVE bounded design; no classroom/local pupil safety release, no guarantee for a particular installation or age group. RSC14–16 source never automatically authorises ST7/8.
decisions.stageCourseBoundary: ST SekI7/8 named compulsory pupil experiment only; no universal other-state or upper-secondary GK/LK obligation. Watching a teacher/partner or paper values does not satisfy it.
decisions.wholeProfileAssessment: Whole old expectations/case bodies and HB electronic-record boundaries remain exactly unchanged. The new Mg cases do not by themselves waive older generic/scope-specific duties. All actual applicable expectations must still be evidenced before whole-goal completion.
openDuties: Local documented expert risk assessment, pupil-specific release, piloted apparatus/reagent and optical controls remain genuine prerequisites.
Real personal execution, dated raw observations and supervision evidence are still absent. Blank protocol/reference text cannot close the experiment.
No full mass-balance/empirical-formula, whole air topic or whole e81 mastery approval is supplied by this source review.

decisions.primaryLocator: ST2022 physical/printed11 plus full27, reaction of metal oxides with water and named magnesium-hydroxide solution pupil experiment; whole text and actual renders read.
decisions.scientificRationaleDe: Der kalte Ansatz mit geprüftem frischem reaktivem MgO und Wasser, Blindprobe, dokumentierter Kontaktzeit, Absetzen/Filtrieren und tatsächlichem Indikatorvergleich ist eine konkrete eigene Herstellung und Untersuchung; es werden keine Sollwerte als Durchführung ausgegeben. MgO+H2O→Mg(OH)2 und das anschließende Gleichgewicht Mg(OH)2(s)⇌Mg2+(aq)+2OH−(aq) sind korrekt. Die ganze Suspension ist nicht die klare wässrige Phase; begrenzte Löslichkeit, Trübung und mögliche langsame Hydratation werden offen behandelt. Der amtliche Lösungsname wird für den kleinen gelösten Anteil erfüllt, nicht durch erfundene vollständige Auflösung. Hersteller-/Versuchsbelege stützen diese qualitative Deutung; keine feste pH-Zahl oder garantierte5-Minuten-Reaktion wird verlangt. Eigene Verbrennungsreste bleiben ausgeschlossen, sodass Restmetall/Nitride die zweite Untersuchung nicht unbemerkt verfälschen.
decisions.scientificRationaleEn: Fresh checked reactive MgO, a cold water preparation, blank, recorded contact time, settling/filtration and actual indicator comparison form a concrete personal preparation and investigation. The hydration equation and small dissolved-ion equilibrium are correct. The suspension is distinguished from its clear aqueous phase; limited solubility, turbidity and slow reaction remain explicit. The official solution name does not warrant complete dissolution, a fixed pH or guaranteed five-minute success. Unverified combustion residues are excluded.
decisions.actualTransfer: Use own solid/filtrate/indicator log to distinguish turbidity from alkalinity and explain clear alkaline liquid; analyse a fresh blank-only alkaline finding as possible carryover, with a safe repeat plan and honest missing/inconclusive data.
decisions.safetyDesignDecision: APPROVE bounded cold small-scale design. No BaO/CaO, sealed shaking, alcohol indicator, heating, acid cleanup or reused burning residues are imported. Local reagent/indicator pilot and release remain required.
decisions.stageCourseBoundary: ST SekI7/8 named compulsory pupil experiment only. Both technical GK/LK views refer to the existing target, not an upper-secondary duty.
decisions.wholeProfileAssessment: New required expectation is explicitly ST-source-conditioned and complements, rather than replaces, all complete old e81/HB duties. No paper route or full-profile completion from the two new blank forms.
openDuties: Actual personal released conduct and an own dated phase/indicator/blank record with supervisor confirmation remain unperformed.
Unclear/no indicator difference is retained and investigated; it must not be counted as successful preparation merely because the reference explanation is known.
No entire ST metal-oxide/bases curriculum, digital presentation, every hydroxyde or precise concentration is approved.
